# ReShade 6.8.0 runtime dependency licenses

These original notices accompany the external ReShade DLL. Dependency revisions follow the ReShade v6.8.0 submodules and embedded About notices; no game resources are included.

ReShade and Dear ImGui notices are retained separately in `../reshade-sdk/` and copied to the release package's `licenses/` directory.

- [MinHook](https://github.com/TsudaKageyu/minhook/blob/8fda4f5481fed5797dc2651cd91e238e9b3928c6/LICENSE.txt) — `MinHook-LICENSE.txt`
- [glad](https://github.com/Dav1dde/glad/blob/27bed1181560211b55e39a9b132fef8c5846aae5/LICENSE) — `glad-LICENSE.txt`
- [UTF8-CPP](https://github.com/nemtrif/utfcpp/blob/819011bb01628fe1aa2f1da9f2c842a48fd5680b/LICENSE) — `UTF8-CPP-LICENSE.txt`
- [stb](https://github.com/nothings/stb/blob/28d546d5eb77d4585506a20480f4de2e706dff4c/LICENSE) — `stb-LICENSE.txt`
- [SPIRV-Headers](https://github.com/KhronosGroup/SPIRV-Headers/blob/7845730cab6ebbdeb621e7349b7dc1a59c3377be/LICENSE) — `SPIRV-Headers-LICENSE.txt`
- [VulkanMemoryAllocator](https://github.com/GPUOpen-LibrariesAndSDKs/VulkanMemoryAllocator/blob/1076b348abd17859a116f4b111c43d58a588a086/LICENSE.txt) — `VulkanMemoryAllocator-LICENSE.txt`
- [OpenXR](https://github.com/KhronosGroup/OpenXR-SDK/blob/288d3a7ebc1ad959f62d51da75baa3d27438c499/LICENSE) — `OpenXR-LICENSE.txt`
- [simple-lossless-encoder](https://github.com/kampidh/simple-lossless-encoder/blob/8dc970fc771e35239db55dfbce8f46f83f8e9b73/LICENSE) — `simple-lossless-encoder-LICENSE.txt`
- [DirectX-Headers](https://github.com/microsoft/DirectX-Headers/blob/9e393d6d8a3b30dcc6f2806ef604ec16a27b0d7e/LICENSE) — `DirectX-Headers-LICENSE.txt`
- [OpenVR](https://github.com/crosire/reshade/blob/v6.8.0/deps/openvr/LICENSE) — `OpenVR-LICENSE.txt`

Additional embedded notices: [EMBEDDED_NOTICES.md](EMBEDDED_NOTICES.md). The original DLL also exposes its embedded notices through ReShade's About panel.
